meta.title: Canada Rockies · Vancouver + Kamloops + Golden + Canmore base loop

flights.note: Arrival time is local Vancouver time.

meta.assumption: Updated: Vancouver nights 23-25 Sep; Kamloops night 26 Sep; Golden night 27 Sep; Canmore begins 28 Sep as the main economical Rockies base; exactly two cabin nights remain 30 Sep and 1 Oct; Vancouver city is reached on 5 Oct; 6 Oct is a full Vancouver city / McArthurGlen day; CX867 departs YVR 14:10 on 7 Oct 2026.
